title: Result of message.get
description: Request args: {"message"}. An identity the table does not hold reads as unknown, with only message, state and epoch: evicted, lost to a reboot or never sent.

message.description: The message's identity: the request id, or "#<issuer>:<job_id>" for a signed request.

hash.description: The native packet hash: the same id a receiver or an observer computes.

to.description: A direct message: the recipient's key prefix.

ack.description: A direct message: the native ACK code, as the app sees it.

est_ms.description: A direct message: the native estimate of the round trip, counted from the transmission.

wait_ms.description: While duty-held: the wait the dispatcher last gave.

epoch.description: This boot. A manager compares it with the epoch of the send's reply: the table does not outlive a reboot.
